title: MyPage
subtitle: Homepage Builder
error_locked: Too many failed attempts. Please wait 15 minutes.
users_hint: Each user gets their own password-protected file area at /bereich. The username is the email address. If a mail server is configured, the user automatically receives their credentials by email.
user_pw_short: Password must be at least 8 characters.
user_pw_mailed: Password changed — user was notified by email
user_created_mailed: User created — credentials sent by email
user_delete_confirm: Really delete user {email} and all their files?
user_smtp_off: Welcome email: no mail server configured
user_no_url_warn: User created, but: the public URL is missing in the Design tab — the email therefore contains no login link!
user_resend_confirm: Resend credentials to {email}? A NEW password will be generated — the old one will no longer work.
user_resent: New password generated and credentials sent
login_msg_hint: Shown to the user after signing in to their personal area (Markdown supported). Leave empty for no message.
welcome_from_hint: Optional alias sender (e.g. noreply@…) specifically for welcome and password emails. Must be configured as an allowed alias on the mailbox. Empty = default sender from the add-on options.
welcome_from_invalid: Please enter a valid email address.
storage_hint: Choose the subfolder on the storage (e.g. SMB share) where user folders should live. Existing files are not moved automatically.
storage_down_admin: The SMB storage is currently unreachable — user files are temporarily offline. The connection is restored automatically (checked every minute).
member_err_storage: The file storage is currently unavailable. Please try again in a few minutes.
member_no_files: No files yet — upload your first one.
member_err_quota: Storage limit reached — the file was not saved.
blog_hint: Posts appear under /blog, the latest three also on the homepage. Markdown is supported.
post_schedule_hint: If set to "Published" with a future date, the post appears automatically from that day on.
allow_indexing_hint: Off = the site asks all search engines not to index it (noindex + robots.txt Disallow) and IndexNow pauses. Default: on.
indexnow_hint: Automatically notifies Bing (and partners like DuckDuckGo/Ecosia) whenever you publish posts/projects — for faster indexing. Requires the public URL to be set. A key is generated automatically and hosted as a file under your domain. (Google does not use IndexNow.)
indexnow_need: Please enable IndexNow, set the public URL and save first.
faq_hint: Frequently asked questions & answers (collapsible on the homepage). Answers support Markdown.
support_hint: Optional link (e.g. Buy Me a Coffee, Ko-fi, PayPal, GitHub Sponsors) — shown as a button in the profile header. The icon is detected automatically.
custom_css_hint: Your own CSS rules for the public page. For advanced users — included as-is.
import_readme: Use the repos' README as detail text
export_hint: Downloads the whole site as a static HTML package (German) — e.g. for GitHub Pages. Contact form and language switcher are disabled in the export.
sensors_hint: The add-on automatically reports sensor.mypage_views_total, sensor.mypage_visitors_total, sensor.mypage_views_today and sensor.mypage_visitors_today to Home Assistant (every 2 minutes).
nf_text: The requested page does not exist (anymore).
err_403_text: You don't have permission for this area. Please sign in or go back.
err_413_text: The uploaded file exceeds the allowed limit. Please reduce its size and try again.
err_500_text: An unexpected error occurred on the server. Please try again later.
skills_hint: Shown as chips on the page. Emojis work too: 🐍 Python
links_hint: Links to other sites. A button appears on the homepage that opens an overview; a click opens the link in a new tab. URL must start with http:// or https://.
links_subtitle: A selection of sites and tools I recommend.
albums_hint: Images are automatically resized on upload (max. 1600 px, WebP). Clicking an album opens a slideshow.
album_protect_hint: Burns the watermark into all album images and disables right-click/drag. Note: full download protection is technically impossible on the web (screenshots always remain). Empty field = "© your-domain.com".
long_hint: With a detail text or gallery the project gets its own subpage, linked from the card.
contact_telegram_hint: Tip: get notified about new messages via Telegram (bot token + chat ID) or email (SMTP) — configurable in the add-on options.
contact_success: Thanks! Your message has been sent.
contact_error: Sending failed. Please try again later.
contact_rate_limited: Too many messages — please try again later.
contact_captcha_wrong: Security question answered incorrectly — please try again.
messages_hint: Messages from the public page's contact form (up to 200 are kept).
maintenance_hint: Takes the public page offline and shows a notice instead (HTTP 503). The admin panel stays available.
maintenance_default: This site is currently under maintenance. Please check back later.
backup_hint: Saves content, statistics, messages and all uploaded images as a ZIP.
confirm_restore: Restore backup? Existing content will be overwritten.
legal_hint_impressum: Required in Germany for non-private sites (§5 DDG). Generate a template, e.g. with the e-recht24.de imprint generator, and paste it here.
legal_hint_privacy: Required by Art. 13 GDPR — among other things because of the visitor log (IP addresses). Generate a template, e.g. with datenschutz-generator.de (free for individuals), and paste it here.
legal_footer_hint: Once text is entered, the links appear automatically in the footer of the public page (/impressum and /datenschutz). Empty pages are not linked.
avatar_hint: Recommended: square image, at least 256×256 px.
error_select: Please select at least one repo.
no_projects_admin: No projects yet — create one or import from GitHub.
tips_hint: Collect several tips — one is shown automatically on the homepage. Markdown allowed.
tips_rotation_hint: With “Random: No” the tips run in order; with “Yes” a random (but identical for all visitors) tip is chosen per day/week.
tips_import_hint: Paste a JSON array (e.g. [{"text_de":"…","text_en":"…"}]). The tips are appended to the list — remember to save afterwards.
tips_import_invalid: Invalid JSON or no tips found.
preview_banner: Preview — this is how the post will look once published (not yet visible to visitors).
field_nav_hint: Header jump links to the sections that exist (Projects, Photos …).
content_acc_hint: Click a section to expand it. “Save” at the bottom stores all sections.
content_dnd_hint: Drag the handle (⠿) to change the order on the homepage; use the eye 👁 to hide a section (content is kept). Both are saved instantly.
section_edit_elsewhere: This section is edited in its own tab – here you can only set its position on the homepage.
services_hint: Your offers or services – with an optional icon (emoji) and price.
testimonials_hint: Client quotes / recommendations with name, role and optional photo.
team_hint: People with photo, role and a short description.
events_hint: Upcoming dates with date, location and optional link.
location_hint: Address, opening hours and an optional map (privacy-friendly, OpenStreetMap).
location_coords_hint: For the map. On openstreetmap.org right-click → “Show address” gives the values.
booking_hint: Optional: link to Calendly, Cal.com etc. Shown as a button next to the support button.
preview_hint: The public page runs on port 17760 — open it in a new tab to see your changes.
crawler_none: No search-engine crawler in the current log yet.
